content: ora2pg latest release v25.0 (2025-04-20 per GitHub API tags on darold/ora2pg). Useful flags for PL/SQL translation: -p/--plsql (enable PLSQL->PLPGSQL conversion, on by default), -i/--input_file (convert a PL/SQL snippet file without an Oracle connection -- usable offline against ddl/src exports), -t/--type (TRIGGER, PROCEDURE, FUNCTION, PACKAGE, VIEW export types), -o/--out, -N/--pg_schema. v25.0 added more Oracle exception mapping and multi-format assessment reports (useful for pre-migration complexity scoring).
